text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's been a few days since Director
Akikawa left.
One day, shortly after I've
sent
<chrname> off to do
some endurance
running...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spot a woman I've never seen before
watching
the Umamusume training.

...You're the trainer of that girl who just
took off
running around the grounds,
aren't you?

I've been watching your training session.
I
understand this is rather impolite to say
upon our
first meeting, but...
You're horribly lax.

You permit her too much solo training,
overlook
her tardiness, and allow her to
chitchat idly with
others during her
breaks.

Oh? Your expression suggests you don't
agree
with my observations.

Then can you tell me how much she's
sleeping on
the daily, and what the
quality of her sleep is?
Are you checking
in with her every day?

Lack of decent sleep not only worsens a
runner's
performance but also invites
accidents. It is
imperative to be aware of
her sleeping habits.

I understand this academy values its
students'
independence.

However, this way of thinking is
irresponsible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She directs her gaze over toward a
mountain in
the distance.

Do you see that cedar-covered
mountain? It's
popular with hikers during
the climbing season.

You'll find magnificent trees that rustle
in the
wind, birds that sing
whole-heartedly, and mulch
that softly
welcomes your feet.

But like most mountains in this country,
it is only
that way due to external care
and management.

Without any sort of outside interference,
the
forests descend into decay. The sun
doesn't reach
the floor, the grass dies,
and the ground becomes
a graveyard of
dead trees and rotting leaves.

Such unkempt mountains are more prone
to
landslides and floods... This is why
management is
so important.

You may feel like a kind and generous
mentor,
watching passively over your
students, but all
you're doing is leaving
their potential to rot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she speaks, the woman's gaze grows
fierce.
The heavy atmosphere is
beginning to feel
overwhelming, but just
then...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
There you are! I was looking for you, Ms.

Kashimoto!

My apologies. I merely wished to
observe a
typical training session.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! I see you've already met
Director
Akikawa's temporary
replacement.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
My name is Riko Kashimoto. I have been
tasked
with managing the academy
during my tenure.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I... look forward to working with you.
